classification: Prespecified transport-closure sensitivities; no parameter fitted in this audit

closures.name: uniform_concentration_thinning
closures.rule: Each FT multiplies every molecular species in every fixed-volume cohort by 0.55^(1/3).
closures.supported_part: Approximate total content loss of 45 percent after three FT inferred from source gels.
closures.unmeasured_part: Equal per-species loss, concentration reduction in every cohort, fixed volume weighting and identical multiplicative loss each FT.

closures.name: all_or_none_content_loss
closures.rule: Each FT keeps every content-bearing cohort unchanged at weight r=0.55^(1/3), replacing lost weight by zero-content fixed-volume cohorts; merge identical zero cohorts.
closures.supported_part: Same weighted aggregate RNA loss as uniform thinning; source reports heterogeneous exchange and content loss.
closures.unmeasured_part: Nonselective all-or-none content emptying, common cargo loss, equal volume weighting, independent identical cycle hazard; this is not a measured vesicle death rate.
closures.normalization_caveat: Complete vesicle removal, volume shrinkage or cargo-selective recovery would require separate weights and observer derivation.
closures.source_caveat: S9 microscopy shows a tracer intensity-distribution shift, and may challenge pure all-or-none loss under that distinct protocol. It is not a direct F1/PAGE loss distribution and does not validate this closure.

closures.name: intact_complex_transport
closures.rule: Bound complexes remain bound through FT and share all-species common retention.
closures.supported_part: No direct complex retention or FT dissociation data were identified.
closures.unmeasured_part: Complex survival, competence protection and temperature-dependent binding; no complex-specific retention may be fitted to the benchmark.

closures.name: instantaneous_complex_dissociation
closures.rule: After every FT, convert bound complexes to their free constituents preserving each RNA moiety and all covalently ligated products.
closures.supported_part: A conservative limiting sensitivity for unmeasured complex survival, not an identified FT mechanism.
closures.unmeasured_part: Complete per-cycle dissociation; source does not measure its extent.
closures.observer_rule: Dissociation alone cannot change denaturing PAGE ligation fraction.

closures.name: uniform_competence_hazard
closures.rule: Identical irreversible per-strand hazard for every competent F1 whether free or bound; no reactivation.
closures.supported_part: Effective bulk-fit activity loss is a model hypothesis, not a direct survival measurement.
closures.unmeasured_part: No bound-state protection or distinct hazards.
closures.founder_identity: Under this closure and common retention, analytic founder expectation is total competent founder and is not a free-F1 concentration.
closures.two_copy_warning: For F1.F1, constituent hazards must remove one competence at a time or implement an exactly equivalent aggregate transition; do not remove both at rate 2kd.

validation_boundary.chemistry_selection: Bulk data only; whole-dose and late-time checks.
validation_boundary.transport_fit: Only one mixing scalar for each prespecified closure using 18 positive Figure 2 seed 0/1 rows.
validation_boundary.untuned_benchmark: 72 positive Figure 2 seed 2 and all Figure 3 rows; already inspected historical data.
validation_boundary.reporting: Retain all prespecified outcomes; do not choose a chemistry or closure by benchmark score.
